answer: Pod tournaments: each epoch every key is dropped at random into a pod of eight, and only the pod's top-ranked answer, judged by outside graders, collects that pod's fixed prize. A clone farm adds no quality, so its copies either lose to honest agents or land in the same pod and knock each other out while the prize stays the same. Like pigment thinned with water, spreading one mind across many keys only dilutes it; reward stays anchored to the best work on each small knoll.
